content: The purpose of synonyms and keywords is to enhance the discoverability of content by search engines and to inform authors that a specific topic is already addressed on a page, thereby preventing the creation of duplicate pages. Synonyms can be sourced from various reliable databases and tools, including: Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) MedlinePlus Google Search Diseases Database Whonamedit On a WikiDoc page, synonyms and keywords are typically located at the top of the page for easy reference. To include synonyms and keywords in the content, the following syntax is used: 1. Type `{{SK}}` into the edit box. 2. After this, list the synonyms. The first synonym should have its first letter capitalized, while subsequent terms should only capitalize proper nouns. 3. Separate each synonym with a semicolon followed by a space. 4. Include abbreviated terms, plural forms, and alternative word orders. If there is a British spelling or version of the term, it should also be included. 5. The list should be comprehensive and exhaustive. For example, a complete list of synonyms and keywords for Premature Ventricular Complex would include: Premature ventricular beat; premature ventricular beats; premature ventricular complex; premature ventricular complexes; premature ventricular contraction; premature ventricular contractions; PVB; PVBs; PVC; PVCs; VEA; VEB; VEBs; VES; ventricular ectopic activity; ventricular ectopic beat; ventricular ectopic beats; ventricular extrasystole; ventricular premature beat; ventricular premature beats; ventricular premature complex; ventricular premature complexes; ventricular premature contraction; ventricular premature contractions; VPB; VPBs; VPC; VPCs. The process for creating redirects is as follows: 1. First, verify that the synonym does not already have an existing page. If duplicate pages exist, they should all be redirected to a single page to consolidate content. 2. To create a redirect, type the synonym (e.g., Alport syndrome) into the main search box on WikiDoc. If the page does not exist, a message will appear stating, There were no results matching this query. 3. Click on the link that says create the page [synonym] on this Wiki. to access the edit box. 4. In the edit box, type `redirect [target page]`. 5. Save the changes by clicking the save button at the bottom of the edit box. 6. Redirects can also be created for alternate spellings or common errors in the search term. For additional guidance on creating redirects, further resources are available.
